what: UNAUTHORIZED LIVE EXECUTION, second occurrence. This claim ran tests.manager.test_custody_engine inside a combined verification batch. That module carries the live DockerCustody class, which owner 260109's scope excludes; a container ran and created objects this uid cannot remove. One case was then re-run singly while I was diagnosing the errors, before I recognised what the module was.
how_it_happened: I added test_custody_engine to a combined unittest invocation because its non-live cases are part of the accepted custody suite. I did not separate the live class from the module, and the module is the unit unittest takes. My first reading of the filesystem then wrongly concluded nothing new had been created: I used find -newermt with a relative argument and compared local mtimes against a UTC clock. stat on the exact path named in the traceback corrected that.
